Class VectorStoreConfig

java.lang.Object
com.cockroachlabs.crdb.ai.VectorStoreConfig
public final class VectorStoreConfig extends Object
Immutable configuration for a VectorStore: table and column names, distance metric, vector dimensionality, and vector-index options for CockroachDB v26.2+.

Build one with builder(). All identifiers are validated to guard against injection, since they are interpolated into DDL/DML.
